speaker: Doctor
text: The smear shows a classic "hobnail" cell with a large basophilic inclusion, which is pathognomonic for Babesia infection, yet your LDH is unexpectedly normal for the degree of hemolysis. Have you recently taken any antibiotics or been prescribed any medications, and do you have a history of splenectomy? REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear_Review; REQUEST TEST: Splenic_Ultrasound
